resources.string: Compare the real cost. Build the smarter basket.
Compare products directly in ValuePilot. Enter two or more products with their package size and price, and ValuePilot will rank the strongest value using its deterministic on-device engine.
Separate each product with a blank line. Keep the product name, package size and price together.

Honeycrisp apples 3 lb $5.99
Gala apples 1.5 kg $4.49
Enter at least two products to compare
The standalone comparison above does not require Accessibility access. If you want experimental live capture from another shopping app, you can enable the optional scanner here.

ValuePilot uses Android Accessibility access only for its optional live-capture feature. It can read product or menu text in the app currently on screen and show the floating comparison panel. Off-screen collection and OCR remain user initiated. Parsing, ranking, the compact classifier and OCR run locally. This build has no INTERNET permission and does not upload screen contents, account credentials or shopping data.

Standalone comparison, deterministic parsing and ranking run on-device. This build has no INTERNET permission and does not send your product text, screen contents, credentials or shopping data to a server.

Automatically reads newly visible product and menu labels in the active app so ValuePilot can compare exact unit value and clearly labeled local estimates. It scrolls only when you explicitly choose off-screen collection; this build has no internet permission.
Use ValuePilot standalone comparison for normal product comparison. Accessibility capture, off-screen collection and OCR remain optional experimental tools.
